page.content:
City of the seven hills, Forum, and later the imperial capital of the west.

How Rome connects

  • Topic: Ancient Rome — The city of Rome is the namesake and first capital of the Roman world.
  • Location: Roman Forum — The Forum sits in the civic heart of Rome.
  • Location: Colosseum — The Colosseum stands in Rome as the Flavian amphitheatre.
  • Location: Pantheon — The Pantheon is Hadrian's temple in the city of Rome.
  • Character: Romulus — Tradition names Romulus as the founder of Rome.

What is Rome?

Rome is the physical city: Palatine and Capitoline, the Forum's political floor, and the later marble of emperors. All Roman offices claimed it even when emperors lived elsewhere.

Key threads lead to Ancient Rome, Roman Forum, Colosseum, Pantheon and Romulus.
